description: This file defines the Account controller class for the OpenCart catalog extension. It manages the retrieval and display of account-related URLs and login status information for the account module view.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Controller class for handling the account module in the OpenCart catalog, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates data with URLs for various account-related pages and returns the rendered view for the account module.
